mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE( IF(tr.uid IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT('uid:', tr.uid)), IF(NULLIF(tr.device_id, '') IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT('device:', tr.device_id)), IF(NULLIF(tr.session_id, '') IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT('session:', tr.session_id)), CONCAT('event:', tr.event_uuid))) FROM tracking_event_record tr WHERE tr.event_name = 'account_register_page_exposure' AND tr.server_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ) AS exposureUsers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE( IF(tr.uid IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT('uid:', tr.uid)), IF(NULLIF(tr.device_id, '') IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT('device:', tr.device_id)), IF(NULLIF(tr.session_id, '') IS NULL, NULL, CONCAT('session:', tr.session_id)), CONCAT('event:', tr.event_uuid))) FROM tracking_event_record tr WHERE tr.event_name = 'account_register_submit' AND tr.server_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ) AS submitUsers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.uid) FROM account a WHERE a.register_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ) AS successUsers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.uid) FROM account a JOIN user u ON u.uid = a.uid AND u.region_id = a.region_id WHERE a.register_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ) AS completedUsers

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS registerDate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.uid) AS registeredUsers FROM account a WHERE a.register_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY registerDate

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.register_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS registerDate, DATEDIFF(DATE(alr.create_time), DATE(a.register_time)) AS dayOffset, COUNT(DISTINCT a.uid) AS retainedUsers FROM account a JOIN account_login_record alr ON alr.uid = a.uid AND alr.region_id = a.region_id WHERE a.register_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND alr.create_time >= DATE(a.register_time) AND alr.create_time <= #{retentionEndTime} AND DATEDIFF(DATE(alr.create_time), DATE(a.register_time)) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.register_time, '%Y-%m-%d'), DATEDIFF(DATE(alr.create_time), DATE(a.register_time)) ORDER BY registerDate, dayOffset

SELECT CASE alr.login_type WHEN 2 THEN 'Google' WHEN 3 THEN 'Facebook' WHEN 4 THEN 'Apple' WHEN 6 THEN 'Line' WHEN 9 THEN 'TikTok' ELSE '其他' END AS channelName, COUNT(0) AS loginCount FROM account_login_record alr JOIN account a ON a.uid = alr.uid AND a.region_id = alr.region_id WHERE alr.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND alr.login_type IN (2, 3, 4, 6, 9)
GROUP BY alr.login_type ORDER BY loginCount DESC
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM account WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND country IS NOT NULL AND country != '' ORDER BY country
SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM account WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND channel IS NOT NULL AND channel != '' ORDER BY channel
SELECT DISTINCT os FROM account WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND os IS NOT NULL AND os != '' ORDER BY os
